0.original: P'obyano requires an adventurer to aid in the fireworks festivities of the Moonfire Faire.<hex:02100103>※This quest is available for a limited time only.

1.original: P'obyano asks that you help light fireworks for the Moonfire Faire. Use the summer firework at three firework mortars located in the vicinity of the Isle of Endless Summer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

2.original: You used the summer firework on the firework mortars. Report back to P'obyano on the Isle of Endless Summer.

3.original: You took word of your deeds back to P'obyano. Speak to her again if you wish to help further with the Moonfire Faire fireworks.

24.original: Use the summer firework on a firework mortar.

48.original: Back for more, are you? I'll not turn away an offer to help. Would you see fit to light some more fireworks for us?

49.original: Just in case you'd forgotten how it is done─you need only throw a summer firework into a firework mortar near where the faire-goers are gathered.

50.original: There is no need for you to speak to Jiriri any further. But this time, I ask that you light fireworks in three locations rather than just the one. Don't overheat out there!

51.original: You simply cannot get enough of these fireworks, can you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Very well, you'll hear no complaints from me.

52.original: The task is the same as before. Light the fireworks by throwing a summer firework into a firework mortar near where our faire-goers are gathered. I will keep an eye to the skies.

53.original: Remember now─you must throw the summer fireworks into three firework mortars. The faire-goers await. Hurry along, now!

54.original: Yet another job well done. Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If you care to help further, you know where to find me. Until then, have a merry Moonfire Faire!
